_: Lora's Spark look pictures. Every look's views live at look/<look-id>/<view>.webp (opaque layers <view>-opaque.webp), 480 px squares on a clear background; the view words come from `views`. `replace` swaps a temporary mannequin render for the finished character render of the same look (from Downloads/@POSTS). app/phiegg/scripts/look-files.py reads this, writes the files, and rewrites every old path in src/data to the new one. Source file names are never used for ours.
